subject: Per lead decision: S19's generated_media queue is the only approval path; your approve route and /admin/generated page are still mounted on shared
body: The approval that publishes is POST /api/admin/queues/generated_media/{id}/approve with params {section_id, caption} (naadi_api/admin/generated_media.py): schema-checked figure node (mediaId only), licence gates, section_media sync, admin_audit, published revision via the 0025 trigger, reindex. Please remove POST /api/admin/generated/{id}/approve, GET /api/admin/generated and the /admin/generated web page (or redirect it to /admin/queues/generated_media), and drop approve_generated or make it unreachable. The S19 queue reads your columns as they are (status 'ready', approved_by/approved_at/media_asset_id); rejection sets approved_by with approved_for_publish false. Tell me if you want a different rejected state.
